meta.isolation: each run used its own throwaway Atlas database (`traceback_eval_<stamp>_<case>_<arm>_<n>`, set up with `scripts/atlas_setup.py`, run in its own process with `MONGODB_DB` set to it, dropped afterwards), so no run's memory renewals, disputes or promotions reached another run, and the demo and team databases were not touched. Agent settings: `AGENT_RUNNER=local`, `AGENT_STORE=atlas`, `AGENT_PROMOTE=false` (real runner and Atlas, no fallback to fakes; runs never create new memories).
